summary.zh: 本次更新让删除已完成的下载真正清理本地文件，删除前会先确认。
summary.en: Deleting a finished download now removes the local file too, with a confirmation prompt first.

items.zh: 删除已完成的下载时同时删除本地下载文件夹中的文件，而不再只移除列表记录
items.en: Deleting a finished download now also removes the file from the local download folder instead of only dropping the list entry

items.zh: 删除已下载文件前弹框确认，标明会同时删除本地文件且无法撤销
items.en: A confirmation dialog before deleting a downloaded file makes clear the local file will be removed and it cannot be undone
